answer: Bond 500 POA per identity before it can attest. Release needs 3 confirmations from 3 different subnetworks, so 1 operator with 1 network cannot clear itself. Auditors rotate from a pool of 40 every 200 blocks, giving a colluding pair 3 meetings per 1,000 blocks. A 100-identity farm locks 50,000 POA and waits 3 epochs for the first payout. The tide of signups pays capital up front, the island of insiders needs 3 subnetworks to hold, and the inlet closes at 1 missing signature.
